available_assertion.statement: The finite etale special map represents the quotient by its computed kernel, by the explicit torsor identity.
available_assertion.objects: The actual finite diagram of O-labelled CM curves, ideal isogenies and selected level subgroups.
available_assertion.hypotheses: Maximal O, q odd inert, fixed place; actual ideal a prime to qN, degree d=Norm(a), and preceding common good models, finite etale kernels and dual identities.
available_assertion.quantifiers: Every selected arrow in each finite diagram.
available_assertion.parameter_range: All allowed prime-power levels including powers of two; q=3 included.
available_assertion.uniformity: The common extension may depend on the finite diagram.
available_assertion.constants: The actual positive integer d, never its residue modulo q.
available_assertion.normalizations: Retain labelled O-action, same tangent embedding, and compatible inverses on the q-divisible group.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: No etaleness of q-primary torsion, no claim of one field for all diagrams, and no class-set bijection follows here.
available_assertion.limit_order: Construct common models and extend maps first; identify kernels and quotient, then preserve level and tangent labels.

source.statement: The finite etale special map represents the quotient by its computed kernel, by the explicit torsor identity.
